sections.title: A clear, traceable research page
paragraphs: Read the source question, mechanism, and conclusions before choosing the page structure. Begin with the config-driven template, then adapt HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when the content calls for it.
This page demonstrates the template. It is not a research paper or an experimental result. A publication page should use the actual paper, public figures, and verifiable citations.
